questions.prompt: Choose the response that best addresses this independent task: FOUNDATION · QUESTION 1 OF 3 In a simple sequential fetch-decode-execute cycle, PC initially holds 70 and memory location 70 contains the instruction LOAD 25. State MAR, MDR, CIR and the next PC value, and explain one action of the control unit. Assume no branch or interrupt. [6]
questions.answer: MAR=70 [1]; the instruction LOAD 25 is fetched from M[70] into MDR [2]; CIR receives LOAD 25 from MDR [1]; PC advances to 71 [1]; the control unit decodes the instruction in CIR [1].
options: MAR=70 [1]; the instruction LOAD 25 is fetched from M[70] into MDR [2]; CIR receives LOAD 25 from MDR [1]; PC advances to 71 [1]; the control unit decodes the instruction in CIR [1].
